verdict.rationale: Airwallex is a business finance and cards platform, so a self-service limit-increase request is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only covers authorization controls and spend controls that set rules on issued cards. Nothing documents a screen or flow where a finance lead can request a higher transaction limit, and those adjacent controls earn no credit.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can request a transaction limit increase directly from a self-service screen
